overview.title: Platform overview

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Buyers, sellers and administrators registered on the platform.
users.search: Search by name, email or phone…
users.suspendBody: {{name}} ({{email}}) will be signed out and unable to log in. Their offers stay but the account can be reactivated at any time.
users.reactivateBody: {{name}} ({{email}}) will be able to log in again.

verifications.title: Seller verification
verifications.subtitle: Review business documents and grant the verified badge.

empty.pending: No pending requests — the queue is clear

verifications.approveBody: {{name}} will receive the verified badge on all offers.
verifications.rejectBody: {{name}} will be notified and can submit a new request.
verifications.rejectPlaceholder: e.g. Certificate copy is unreadable, please upload again

catalog.title: Products & categories
catalog.subtitle: Manage product categories and review the product catalogue.
catalog.dialogHint: Names are shown in all three interface languages.
catalog.slugHint: Lowercase latin letters, digits and hyphens, 2–40 characters

errors.slug: Use 2–40 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens
errors.slugTaken: This slug is already in use
errors.name: At least 2 characters

offers.title: Market offers
offers.subtitle: All listings on the platform. Suspicious prices and reported offers are highlighted.
offers.flaggedHint: Showing offers priced below 0.4× or above 2.5× the product median, or with open reports.
offers.noFlagged: No flagged offers — nothing needs attention
offers.ratioTooltip: Offer price divided by the median price of active offers for this product
offers.removeBody: “{{title}}” by {{seller}} will be hidden from the market. You can restore it later.
offers.notePlaceholder: e.g. Price 3× above market, seller contacted

prices.title: Price monitoring
prices.subtitle: Weekly price movers, spikes and the supply situation per product.
prices.spikesHint: Products whose average price moved {{pct}}% or more in a week
prices.moversHint: Average price now vs. a week ago
prices.supplyHint: Observed platform metrics and estimated signals (marked *)

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Offers reported by users, and a log of every admin action.

resolve.title: Resolve this report?
resolve.body: Mark the report on “{{title}}” as resolved. The offer stays on the market.

remove.title: Resolve and remove the offer?
remove.body: “{{title}}” will be removed from the market and the report resolved.

dismiss.title: Dismiss this report?
dismiss.body: The report on “{{title}}” will be closed with no action.

analytics.title: Platform analytics
analytics.subtitle: How listings, users and demand are distributed across the platform.
analytics.regionHint: Offer views per region, with active offers
analytics.sdHint: Each dot is a product: active offers (observed) against the interest index (estimated). Size = searches.
